candidates.title: Uttar Pradesh teen kills his mother for opposing sex change
candidates.excerpt: In Lucknow, a 17-year-old allegedly killed his 42-year-old mother following an argument about gender-affirming surgery. The minor had been living as a female and wanted to undergo surgery. An altercation reportedly arose when the mother advised against the procedure. The teenager attacked her with an iron wrench, resulting in fatal injuries. He subsequently informed the police about the incident himself.

candidates.title: BRS leaders hit back at Revanth Reddy over Sircilla speech
candidates.excerpt: BRS leaders from the erstwhile Karimnagar district criticised Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy over his Sircilla speech, alleging he focused on attacks against BRS leaders instead of development issues. They sought action on pending projects, weavers’ schemes and Dalit Bandhu funds.
